people.name: Sarah
people.line: Wife of Abraham; mother of Isaac

translations.web: Is anything too hard for Yahweh? At the set time I will return to you, when the season comes round, and Sarah will have a son.”
translations.bsb: Is anything too difficult for the LORD? At the appointed time I will return to you—in about a year—and Sarah will have a son.”
translations.kjv: Is any thing too hard for the LORD? At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.
translations.asv: Is anything too hard for Jehovah? At the set time I will return unto thee, when the season cometh round, and Sarah shall have a son.
